channel.display-name: Sky Cinema Sci Fi & Horror HD

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: A rich property developer wants to take over an exclusive country club and so challenges its pompous president to a game of golf leading to utter mayhem, and a stream of surreal and crude visual gags.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Tale about an unconventional sleuth's attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Sequel about the zany private detective who specialises in locating missing pets. Ace Ventura travels to Africa to search for a kidnapped sacred albino bat, which reputedly has the power to restore peace between two warring tribes.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving whose thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together in.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Anna Scott is the most famous actress in the world, and William Thacker a second hand bookshop owner in Notting Hill. After colliding in the street they begin a relationship which is soon fraught with complications as the tabloid press hound Anna. William must then summon all his charm, ingenuity and patience if there is to be a happy ending.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Believing it essential before they go to college, four teenage boys vow to lose their virginity and enter into a pact, each attempting to be the first to do the deed as their efforts are met with varying levels of success and failure.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Comic tale in which a tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: It's the 90s and, while the world has moved on, they haven't, with parents Mike and Carol and their brood now irritating anachronisms rather than the loved, slightly goofy family. As they've forgotten to pay their property taxes, next-door neighbour Mr Diymeyer can buy up their home and raze it to the ground as part of his property development schemes. Can the family raise $20,000 in just one week?

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.

programme.title: Addams Family Values

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Kirk, now an admiral, is called upon to take command of his old ship one last time in order to intercept a bizarre and deadly force heading towards Earth. One by one, he reassembles the original crew, and they set out to save the planet.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: The past returns to haunt Admiral James Kirk when he and his crew become locked in a battle of wits with an old nemesis. His enemy Khan is looking for revenge and a potentially destructive device.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Kirk and the Enterprise crew defy Starfleet and return to the Genesis planet to reunite Spock's body and spirit.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Kirk and company travel back in time to 20th-century San Francisco, where two whales hold the key to Earth's future.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: The Klingon Empire is falling apart and they want peace with the Federation. Hiowever, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soren. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: The crew of the Enterprise learns of a plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, and Capt Picard begins an open rebellion to defend the planet's people as well as the very ideals the Federation was founded.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A resourceful teen takes her younger sister's place in a brutal contest in which youths from each of 12 districts fight to the death on live television.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen finds herself in District 13 after she destroys the Games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her courage.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to launch an assassination attempt on President Snow.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree, until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. Can Dave come to their rescue?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: Through a series of misunderstandings, Alvin, Simon and Theodore come to believe that Dave is going to propose to his new girlfriend in New York City, and dump them. They have three days to get to him and stop the proposal.

When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: It's all about quick and fabulous suppers as Clodagh shares four all-time favourites. She's making a foolproof Easy Fast Chicken Curry and collecting eggs from her hens for a snappy solo supper of Creamy Gruyère Baked Eggs in the garden. Then she's taking an emotional trip down memory lane to share incredible Speedy Pancetta and Garlic Mussels inspired by her dad that she's making in her outdoor kitchen, before whipping up a pan of cheesy lemony Late Night Alfredo Pasta.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: The latest national and international news.

programme.title: Nations Championship LIVE
programme.desc: England continue their autumn campaign in the Nations Championship with a massive test of their credentials against New Zealand at the Allianz Stadium. The two sides last met a year ago when England were in irresistible form as they surged to a 33-19 victory. After a poor Six Nations, another win against Dave Rennie's new look All Blacks would be massive confidence boost for Steve Borthwick and his charges. Mark Pougatch is joined by Ugo Monye, Sean Fitzpatrick and Danny Care for live coverage.

programme.title: Nations Championship LIVE
programme.desc: Ireland continue their autumn campaign in the Nations Championship with a crunch match against the World Champions South Africa in Dublin. The two sides last met a year ago when the Springboks produced a scrummaging masterclass to earn a first win at the Aviva Stadium in thirteen years. Andy Farrell has admitted his Irish side are a work in progress and will need his experienced men like Tadhg Furlong, Andrew Porter and Jamison Gibson-Park to stand up and be counted.

Kelvin, meanwhile, misses having his cattle alongside him. A visit to the cattle sheds gives him the chance to admire this year's entries and learn more about dairy cows.

programme.title: EFL Championship LIVE
programme.desc: Burnley take on Blackburn Rovers in the East Lancashire Derby, and there is famous and old rivalry between the two clubs. Burnley were relegated from the Premier League last season, and have struggled so far in the second tier they parted company with their manager Nicky Hayen last month, and Fabio Celestini is now in charge.

programme.title: Pfarrer Braun
programme.desc: Mit der Versetzung nach bedankt sich Bischof Hemmelrath bei Pfarrer Braun. Das rosengeschmückte Idyll des Rheinstädtchens gefällt auch der Roßhauptnerin: Brauns patente Haushälterin findet hier einen Verehrer, der in ihr nicht nur romantische Gefühle, sondern auch die Hoffnung auf eine blaublütige Abstammung weckt. Während ihre Adelsträume sich jedoch als Schäume erweisen, muss Pfarrer Braun einem echten Adeligen geistigen Beistand leisten.

programme.title: Skin on Skin
programme.desc: Ein industrieller Schlachthof irgendwo in Deutschland. Jakob arbeitet als Wachmann, der bosnische Arbeiter Boris in der Schlachtung. Inmitten von Gewalt und Kälte entsteht zwischen ihnen eine stille Verbindung und die unausgesprochene Sehnsucht.

programme.title: Out of the Blue
programme.desc: Marie und ihre beste Freundin Tara machen eine Ausbildung in einem ländlichen Hotel. Ihre Zeit vertreiben sie sich mit TikTok-Videos und träumen davon, viral zu gehen.

programme.title: Ein Ferienhaus in Marrakesch
programme.desc: Geld allein macht nicht glücklich. Das erfährt der frischgebackene Lottomillionär Kurt Basinski schmerzlich, als ihn seine Frau verlässt. Um den traurigen Glückspilz aufzumuntern, bucht seine Mutter einen gemeinsamen Urlaub in einem Luxus-Ferienhaus in Marrakesch. Doch seine Lebensgeister erwachen erst wieder, als er sich in die hübsche Köchin Mona verliebt. Kurt schmiedet nun eigene Zukunftspläne - die aber mit den Geschäftsideen seiner Mutter völlig inkompatibel sind.

programme.title: Der scheinheilige Nikolaus
programme.desc: Der achtjährige Artem verbringt zusammen mit seiner Familie Weihnachten in den Bergen. Das Haus ist marode, der Vater stürzt, als er das Dach flicken will. Artems Eltern machen sich auf den Weg zum Arzt und ein Dieb kommt durch den Kamin ins Haus.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon's first day of college is derailed by his new philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson; Mary and Brenda live vicariously through Missy's first day of middle school.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Meemaw takes matters into her own hands when Sheldon's philosophy teacher sends him into a tailspin; George Sr. learns Georgie has been cutting class.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon and George Sr. dine with President Hagemeyer and a university benefactor; Georgie gives Missy some brotherly advice when Mary won't let her go to the school dance; Dale and June convince Meemaw to attend their son's wedding.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon campaigns to become Dr. Linkletter's lab assistant; Georgie enlists the help of Mr. Lundy, the drama teacher, for a surprising business venture.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Dr. Linkletter pushes Sheldon to make friends with his fellow students at college; Georgie gets a pager.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Exceptional but misunderstood nine-year-old Sheldon Cooper skips four grades to start high school along with his less-intellectual older brother.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: When Sheldon refuses to ride in a car after getting into an accident with Meemaw, Missy uses their trauma to her advantage at school; Meemaw is forced to take the church shuttle while her car is in the shop.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In the last episode of season five, Bernadette decides that she wants to be married to Wolowitz before his NASA space mission takes place. They scramble to organise a wedding ceremony at City Hall in the short time available, but their plans go awry. Can their friends step in to find an ordained minister and a romantic wedding venue before it's too late?

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard gets caught in an argument between his mum and Bernadette while at the International Space Station. Meanwhile, Ray is feeling lonely so Sheldon invites him along to his second anniversary date with Amy.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon intervenes when he learns that Penny is thinking about breaking up with Leonard, but he is hampered by his inability to keep a secret. Meanwhile, in space, Howard is being picked on by the other astronauts.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Amy is jealous when Sheldon hires an attractive female assistant named Alex. However, it turns out that Alex is more interested in Leonard, which makes Penny feel threatened. Meanwhile, Howard discovers that his return from space has been delayed by a week and the pressure begins to take its toll on his mind.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Wolowitz is disappointed when he doesn't receive a hero's welcome on his return from space. Bernadette is out of action with a heavy cold, his mother is occupied with her dentist, Koothrappali has a new best friend, and Sheldon, Amy, Leonard and Penny are deeply involved in an ultra-competitive games night. Will Wolowitz ever get the recognition he deserves as an astronaut?

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The gang celebrates Halloween with a fancy dress party at Stuart's comic book shop, but Sheldon and Amy can't agree about which costumes to wear. Leonard and Penny get a new spark in their relationship when she visits him at his laboratory. Howard just can't stop talking about his trip to space, much to the irritation of his friends, and it takes a word from astronaut Buzz Aldrin to get his feet back on the ground.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon gets excited when Stephen Hawking agrees to play against him in an online game of `Words with Friends'. However, when Sheldon starts to dominate the game, Hawking is less than pleased. Elsewhere, Penny signs up for a class at community college but feels reluctant to tell Leonard about it.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Amy gets upset when Sheldon fails to defend her in an argument with Wil Wheaton during the filming of a new episode of `Fun with Flags'. Bernadette pressures Howard to move the rest of his possessions out of his mother's house and into her flat.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The guys notice that Sheldon disappears for 20 minutes right after lunch every day. Filled with curiosity, they attempt to follow him and work out what on earth he's been doing. Meanwhile, Penny befriends a British student in her class and they start exchanging text messages, which makes Leonard jealous, so he tries to discourage their friendship.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: When non-driver Sheldon finds out that his unused parking space at the university has been reallocated to Howard he feels undermined. Howard doesn't see the problem in using something that his friend doesn't need and the two fall out. As their disagreement escalates, each begins to steal items that are not being used at the time from the other, while Amy and Bernadette gradually get drawn into the dispute.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon begrudgingly takes care of Amy when she is sick, but she loves the extra attention so much that she is still pretending to be ill long after her recovery is complete. Bernadette arranges for Howard to go on a fishing trip with her macho father, hoping that they will bond.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon unwillingly reveals some painful memories of Christmas past when Leonard persuades him to join in with a seasonal game of Dungeons & Dragons. When Raj joins Penny, Bernadette and Amy on a ladies' night out, they attempt to find the perfect girl for him after he reveals the truth about some of his crushes.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: A surprised Leonard finally comes to the realisation that Sheldon's assistant, Alex, is attracted to him.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The guys are stranded in the middle of nowhere when Leonard's car is stolen on the way to the Bakersfield Comic-Con. Back home, the women try to figure out why the guys are so fascinated with comic books.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howards's nerd hobby gets him into money troubles, Sheldon is forced to work with Kripke while in competition with Kripke, ends up spreading rumors about his sexual relationship with Amy.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: With Leonard mad at Sheldon, he moves in with Penny. Amy notes that she would be the perfect roommate for Sheldon since she knows him so well and he wouldn't have to break in someone else.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The couples are getting for Valentine's Day, Leonard, Penny, Howard and Bernadette are going to dinner and Sheldon and Amy are trying to get the perfect gifts for each other.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: After a terrible date with Lucy, the girl he met at Stuart's comic book shop singles party, Raj vows never to leave his flat or interact with another woman again. Leonard, Howard and Bernadette attempt to cheer him up, with little success. Sheldon asks Penny to help him record a new episode of Fun with Flags, and her useful tips leave him deeply impressed by her acting skills.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Raj and Lucy have their first date meeting in a library and texting to each other and the guys have to promote science careers for women at Howard's old middle school, while the girls go to Disneyland.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny and Leonard host a cocktail party. Meanwhile, Howard receives a letter from his father, whom he hasn't heard from since he was 11.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Dr. Sandra Lee treats Taylore, a young woman with elf-like bumps on her ears and Jose never goes out because of the baseball-sized lump on his head.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.title: Géopolitis
programme.desc: Serbie, victoire de la rue Le mouvement des étudiants a remporté la majorité absolue aux législatives anticipées, après deux ans de mobilisation massive contre la corruption. Le leader nationaliste Alexandar Vu ?i ? concède sa défaite après quatorze ans au c?ur du pouvoir. Invitée : Natasha Wunsch, professeure, codirectrice du Centre d'études européennes à l'université de Fribourg Présentation : Mélanie Ohayon.

programme.title: La p'tite librairie
programme.desc: François Busnel propose chaque jour de découvrir ou redécouvrir une ?uvre française ou étrangère : roman, essai, grand classique ou encore bande dessinée.

programme.title: Nous, les Européens
programme.desc: À travers ses reportages et ses chroniques, cette émission aborde le sujet de l'Europe, mais surtout des personnes qui font l'Europe, et de toutes les initiatives positives et inspirantes qui fleurissent sur le continent.

programme.title: La table du fermier
programme.desc: C'est l'automne ! Les légumes sont récoltés et conservés pour l'hiver afin d'approvisionner le restaurant. La microbrasserie Dunham en utilise pour produire une bière gastronomique.

programme.title: Château !
programme.desc: Unique en France car il est le seul château-pont, le château de Chenonceau cache entre ses murs des histoires captivantes du passé. Le château de Talcy, à l'inspiration poétique, incarne quant à lui un refuge enchanteur.

programme.title: Histoires et leçons
programme.desc: Les histoires voyagent à travers le temps et l'espace et portent des valeurs humaines universelles. Un conte venu d'un pays différent à chaque épisode !

programme.title: My Class
programme.desc: Quand un élève a un problème à résoudre, il doit réfléchir. Direction Cerveau City pour convoquer toutes ses connaissances. Dès que l'alerte sonne, Mémo et Erreur mènent l'enquête en accédant aux gardiens de la langue française.

programme.title: Les nouvelles aventures de Kaeloo
programme.desc: Quatre meilleurs amis légèrement déjantés, Kaeloo la grenouille, Moignon l'écureuil, Coin-Coin le canard et Monsieur Chat, partagent ensemble de nombreuses aventures complètement folles.

programme.title: Dessine les animaux avec Koumi
programme.desc: Koumi, 6 ans, gaie et espiègle, rêve de connaître tous les animaux du monde. En plus de ça, elle adore dessiner. Dans chaque épisode, elle explique comment bien dessiner les animaux.

programme.title: Ta vie sans ça
programme.desc: Quelle serait notre vie sans les objets du quotidien ? Dans chaque épisode, l'un d'entre eux est mis en avant. Qu'il s'agisse du robinet, du parapluie ou de la brosse à dents, ils ont tous une histoire à raconter.

programme.title: Jad et ses s?urs
programme.desc: Ranya et Syrine, deux soeurs jumelles, sont aussi adorables qu'inséparables. Leur vie est joyeuse et pleine de petites aventures du quotidien, mais tout va être chamboulé avec l'arrivée de leur petit frère, Jad.

programme.title: Comme des têtes pas de poule
programme.desc: De retour de New York, Vic veut tenter sa chance comme professeure de danse. Sigis doit rédiger un hommage à son grand-père décédé, mais il a du mal à trouver les mots. Yann Tanguay, Eza Peventi (saison 3, Canada, 2025)

programme.title: Roi Keïta
programme.desc: Tout juste monté sur le trône, Soundiata Keïta a la lourde responsabilité de veiller à la stricte application des nouvelles règles du royaume. Avec humour et bienveillance, il endosse son rôle de souverain pour rendre le Mali prospère.

programme.title: Hiveraganza
programme.desc: Les élèves de la polyvalente des Monts de Sainte-Agathe-des-Monts et du collège Villa Maria de Montréal s'affrontent aux jeux tirs de barrage et disco polaire.

programme.title: Foot GO
programme.desc: Tata est une petite fille de 8 ans qui a beaucoup d'ambition. Malgré son jeune âge, elle se bat contre la société pour accomplir son rêve : jouer au football et créer son club de football féminin.

programme.title: Foot GO
programme.desc: Tata est une petite fille de 8 ans qui a beaucoup d'ambition. Malgré son jeune âge, elle se bat contre la société pour accomplir son rêve : jouer au football et créer son club de football féminin.

programme.title: Mission info
programme.desc: L'émission d'information des 7-11 ans! Chaque épisode, pensé pour les enfants et leurs parents, offre un éclairage accessible aux plus jeunes, en mêlant explications, reportages immersifs, interviews d'experts.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: La Méditerranée, creuset de multiples civilisations, est au centre de tous les changements, conflits et évolutions de notre siècle. L'émission propose des enquêtes, des portraits, un regard différent sur le monde méditerranéen.

programme.title: Basik
programme.desc: Magazine hebdomadaire de reportages. Chaque semaine, Basik explore des problématiques liées à l'économie, à l'argent, aux énergies, et au quotidien des romand.e.s. Basik met les histoires et les destins personnels en avant.

programme.title: Objectif Monde L'hebdo
programme.desc: Le magazine des rédactions francophones propose des enquêtes d'investigation sur des thèmes majeurs de société ou de géopolitique, grâce à l'expertise et aux regards croisés des journalistes et spécialistes.

programme.title: Maghreb-orient-express
programme.desc: Ne manquez pas votre rendez-vous culturel en Méditerranée. Afin de maintenir la connexion avec le(s) monde(s) arabe(s), le journaliste Mohamed Kaci reçoit les personnalités qui font l'actualité à Alger, Tunis, Rabat, Beyrouth, ou encore Le Caire.

programme.title: Le Journal de la RTBF
programme.desc: Le journal télévisé préparé par la rédaction de la RTBF.

programme.title: Destination Francophonie
programme.desc: Destination le Cambodge où, dans les universités royales du pays, les étudiants se forment dans différentes disciplines en français. Une tradition mais aussi un nouvel attrait dans ce pays où la francophonie connaît un renouveau.

programme.title: Adamo, le film de sa vie
programme.desc: Dans ce documentaire exclusif, 17 des plus fervents admirateurs d'Adamo racontent les étapes importantes de sa vie d'artiste. Joëlle Scoriels accueillera Adamo dans une salle bruxelloise où ses fans seront impatients de le retrouver.

programme.title: Questions pour un champion
programme.desc: Quatre concurrents s'affrontent et doivent répondre à des questions de culture générale au cours de trois manches successives. Le candidat le moins performant est éliminé à la fin de chaque tour.

programme.title: La table du fermier
programme.desc: C'est l'automne ! Les légumes sont récoltés et conservés pour l'hiver afin d'approvisionner le restaurant. La microbrasserie Dunham en utilise pour produire une bière gastronomique.

programme.title: Un Pays, Un Livre
programme.desc: Augustin Trapenard propose un tour du monde des littératures francophones contemporaines.

programme.title: 64' le monde en français - 1re partie
programme.desc: Le grand rendez-vous de l'information qui donne à voir l'actualité internationale décryptée par le monde francophone, grâce à ses télévisions partenaires et à l'expertise de ses correspondants dans le monde.

programme.title: Terriennes
programme.desc: Cette chronique est dédiée à la condition des femmes. Au travers de nombreuses thématiques et problèmes de société, l'émission combat les clichés et les idées reçues, puis encourage la solidarité entre les femmes.

programme.title: La Météo
programme.desc: Bulletin météorologique.

programme.title: 64' le monde en français - 2e partie
programme.desc: Grande édition internationale en langue française, cette émission met l'accent sur l'actualité mondiale, l'actualité francophone, culturelle, politique, économique, sociale, et sociétale.

programme.title: Les routes du goût : la ballade d'Emma
programme.desc: Alfonso Iaccarino chef de renom nous conduit à la découverte d'un restaurant à Naples.

programme.title: Rassemblance
programme.desc: Née à Sarajevo, arrivée enfant à Québec, Jelena a fui la guerre en ex-Yougoslavie avec ses parents. Aujourd'hui comédienne, formée au Conservatoire d'art dramatique de Québec, elle navigue entre scène, écran et engagement artistique.

programme.title: Le journal de la RTS
programme.desc: Le journal télévisé préparé par la rédaction de la RTS.

programme.title: La Météo
programme.desc: Bulletin météorologique.

programme.title: L'invité
programme.desc: Patrick Simonin reçoit chaque jour un acteur de l'actualité politique, économique, sociale ou culturelle et se livre à une interview de huit minutes afin de donner les clés des évènements aux spectateurs.

programme.title: Ligue 1 McDonald's
